summary: This class discusses how the custom of fasting during the weeks of Shovavim was replaced by Taanit Dibur through the work of Hacham Yisrael Al-Fia. The speaker explains the books written by Hacham Yisrael Al-Fia, the reasons people can no longer withstand physical fasts, and how the practice of a one-day Taanit Dibur was publicized and adopted in Brooklyn synagogues.
questions: How was the custom of fasting during Shovavim replaced?
Who was Hacham Yisrael Al-Fia and what books did he write?
Why did Hacham Yisrael Al-Fia say people can no longer do traditional fasts?
How does a one-day Taanit Dibur replace multiple fasts?
How was Taanit Dibur practiced in Brooklyn community synagogues?
